QUEENMOD2-SWARM.description: When on enemies, deal damage at the end of the turn. When on allies, gain Block at the end of the turn. Moves to enemies and allies you target, and returns to you when you gain Block. Reduced by 1 each turn.
QUEENMOD2-SWARM.title: Swarm
QUEENMOD2-HIVE.title: Hive
QUEENMOD2-HONEYCOMB.title: Honeycomb
QUEENMOD2-MULTIPLY.description: At the start of combat, add 2 additional copies of this card to your Draw Pile.
QUEENMOD2-MULTIPLY.title: Multiply
QUEENMOD2-HIVETIP.description: Hive cards draw 1 card when drawn, and include Hornets, Bumblebees, Honeybees and Drones. (Strong damage, block, energy and draw cards.)
QUEENMOD2-HIVETIP.title: Hive Cards
QUEENMOD2-HIVEBOUND.description: Triggers at the start of every turn while this is in your Draw Pile.
QUEENMOD2-HIVEBOUND.title: Hivebound
QUEENMOD2-DANCE.description: Triggered when a specific random sequence of card types are played while in hand. Changes each turn.
QUEENMOD2-DANCE.title: Dance
QUEENMOD2-STRATEGIZE.description:
Draws a specific type of card. Changes after you play a card. 
 (Attack -> Block Skill -> Utility Skill -> Power -> Attack)
QUEENMOD2-STRATEGIZE.title: Strategize
